releaseNotes: Added public AniList import for Anime Tracker using a username or profile link, with safe merging that keeps local notes and favorites.
Expanded Anime Tracker details with richer search results, detail pages, characters, voice actors, score/status data, episodes, and improved watchlist layout.
Improved Media Downloader validation, metadata display, download actions, and the beta BPM & Key Finder with bundled Essentia support.
Improved File Converter advanced options layout, queue spacing, drag-and-drop area, and save flow.
Added Auto Clicker alternating outputs and keyboard output bindings, plus many UI spacing, scrolling, dropdown, theme, and performance improvements.
